development: 50 frozen Study B DIV2K development images, each at sigma 0.6, 1.2, and 3.0
estimator: RGB channel mean followed by the sum of mean squared horizontal and vertical second differences divided by the sum of mean squared first differences plus 1e-12; lower means smoother
thresholds: always pass, always clean, and empirical development proxy quantiles 0.05, 0.10, ..., 0.95 (NumPy linear quantiles); clean strictly below the threshold
privileged_thresholds: always pass, clean at sigma >= 3.0, clean at sigma >= 1.2, always clean
objective: maximize mean input-minus-policy LPIPS over all 150 equally weighted development source-severity pairs
constraint: at most 5% of development source-severity pairs may lose more than 1 dB PSNR relative to input
justification: 1 dB corresponds to about 26% more squared error. The 5% budget limits sizeable errors while allowing a small tail in this exploratory audit. This is an engineering trade-off.
ties: maximize LPIPS improvement, then minimize serious-harm count, then minimize number cleaned, then take earlier grid entry
transfer: apply both frozen rules without refitting on 99 DIV2K and the frozen 100 ImageNet IDs; report each severity and domain separately
information: the proxy uses the observation only. True synthetic sigma is privileged. Clean references are used for development selection and final scoring only
